Why so many kids run from Nova Scotia's group homes
September 28|
Duration

Newly obtained data shows children have been reported missing from group homes in Nova Scotia hundreds of times. The CBC's Shaina Luck speaks with people whose lives are forever shaped by growing up in government care. This story is part of Left Behind, a series produced by the CBC's Atlantic Investigative Unit.
